source_claim: The official PLAYISM product page identifies Madotsuki as the main character of YUMENIKKI -DREAM DIARY-, describes that title as a diverging follow-up to Yume Nikki, and says it was created with Kikiyama's supervision and full cooperation in respect of the original release.
notes: The publisher page names only Madotsuki among the campaign targets. Its account connects this returning character to the original Yume Nikki work; the other campaign members are not inferred from this page.
